title: Unicorn Meadow
description: A unicorn farm for kids. Feed your unicorns, play balloons and ball with them, brush off the mud and style their manes, tails, colors and outfits. Grow apples and carrots, build the meadow, and adopt new foals with the stars happy unicorns drop.
controls: Tap a unicorn to care for it, tap trees and gardens to pick food, tap stars to collect them. 🔨 builds and moves things, 🦄 adopts a foal. In care, rub the unicorn to pet or brush it.
requirements: Any modern browser. Saves the farm in this browser.
